channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Daniel Gafford | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Daniel Gafford from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nico Harrison on Daniel Gafford, PJ Washington
item.description:
“For us to reach our goals, we need that fan base. And to be honest with you, every trade I've made since I've been here has not been regarded as a good trade, and so sometimes it takes time. When I traded for Kyrie, it was met with a lot of skepticism and it was graded as a terrible trade and you didn't see it rightaway, but eventually everyone agreed that that was a great trade. When I traded for [Gafford] and [Washington] again, it was like, 'Oh, he gave up way too much. These guys aren't going to help us.' Now that trade, you saw the evidence a lot sooner. So I think a lot of times trades take a little bit of time.”

Nico Harrison on Daniel Gafford, PJ Washington, Apr 15, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Daniel Gafford
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Daniel Gafford's return from a one-game absence with an ankle sprain:

“Norestrictions. We’re happy to have him back against a big team like Portland. The way our injuries have gone, it’s been weeks behind it instead of days. We’re happy that he healed quickly.”

Jason Kidd on Daniel Gafford, Jan 9, 2025. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Daniel Gafford
item.description:
Kidd on Gafford:

“It happens. First playoff game for this group. Could be nerves. Give the Clippers credit. They were the better team.”

Jason Kidd on Daniel Gafford, Apr 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Taj Gibson on Kristaps Porzingis, Daniel Gafford
item.description:
Christos Tsaltas:Taj Gibson on Porzingis and Gafford:

“Porzingis is a talent. Gafford is a young athlete talent. I want to be myself. Those two guys are extremely talented and sky is the limit”

Taj Gibson on Kristaps Porzingis, Daniel Gafford, Jul 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @Tsaltas46.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Wilt Chamberlain, Daniel Gafford
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Kyle Kuzma on Daniel Gafford:

“I call him Wilt Chamberlain sometimes. He just be blocking shit for no reason.”

Kyle Kuzma on Wilt Chamberlain, Daniel Gafford, Nov 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Daniel Gafford
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Bradley Beal on Daniel Gafford's defense:

“His rim protection is up there with some of the best in the league... his ceiling is whatever he wants it to be, honestly.”

Bradley Beal on Daniel Gafford, Oct 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Daniel Gafford
item.description:
Bradley Beal on Daniel Gafford as a lob threat:

“We feel we have two of the best playmaking guards in the league... If you step up to stop us, it's going to be on top of your head with Gaff.”

Bradley Beal on Daniel Gafford, May 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Daniel Gafford
item.description:
“I could’ve hit Daniel. I could’ve kicked it back out. I thought I was making the right play by trying to get in the air and get to the free throw line. It just didn’t happen.”

Zach LaVine on Daniel Gafford, Dec 10, 2019. Source: NBC Sports.
